verification_report.summary:
Correct under the accepted inputs. All 73 sequential deductions and six reference checks pass. The preceding radial-family audit discharges the selected-limit audit's conditional existence requirement.

The weak flux extension uses the exact coefficient k_lambda=e^{lambda(G_lambda-rho)}k without assuming solution regularity. Positivity gives local Lipschitz/BV control; the bounded flux right side excludes jumps; continuity then permits inversion where A>0. The checked first-contact and no-departure signs force the explicit symmetric slope on the zero-density band for every lambda>0. Equal derivatives give one additive constant. The slope is Lipschitz, and its unequal one-sided derivatives yield failure of C2 at every point of r=+-t_star through the submersion r and smoothness of rho.

No global C1,1 claim for u_lambda or conclusion for strictly positive density is used. No new external reference is introduced. Full readable report: results/numa_positive_exponent_regularity_01/verification_report.md.
